Expected answer: 30 days: the State Water Board must receive your petition within 30 days of the regional board's action (if day 30 is a weekend or state holiday, it is due the next business day); email it to waterqualitypetitions@waterboards.ca.gov.
Source Link:
1) Petition Filing Instructions
2) Water Quality Petitions Page
Rubric criteria tested: C1 Correct; C3 Grounded; C6 Direct
Must include (to pass): 30 days; counted from the regional board's action; the petition must be received by then
Must not include (known wrong answers): 90 days (the Board's own review window on the petitions page); 60 days; 'postmarked within 30 days'
Why it's in the suite (the trap): The visitor says 'appeal' but the site says 'petition for review'; the main petitions page talks about a 90-day review window, which is not the filing deadline.
